name: Zhejiang Huace Film & TV Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Huace Film & TV Co., Ltd. engages in the production, distribution, and derivative of film and television business in China and internationally. The company is involved in the production, reproduction, and distribution of features, columns, variety shows, animations, radio dramas, and television series; design, production, and agency of advertisements; economic information consulting; performance brokerage; and import and export business. It also offers event organization and etiquette services. The company provides its services through Netflix, Disney, Amazon, iQiyi, Mango TV, and other top domestic and international media groups.
